items.title: Reflecting On Shelf-Stable Food Stocks’ Q2 Earnings: General Mills (NYSE:GIS)

items.title: General Mills’ CEO says M&A not a priority in challenging environment
items.summary: Jeff Harmening said there is a “high bar” for acquisitions, but the food maker could consider additional divestitures.

items.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks with Open Questions
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

items.title: Passive Income Investors Are Buying 5 Well-Known High-Yield Stocks Near 52-Week Lows
